---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters, const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                      const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating Every candidate cluster is grown by one\n//            thread block; the block keeps an incremental \"max distance to any\n//            current member\" value per candidate point (max is associative, so\n//            this is mathematically identical to the O(k) rescan of the\n//            sequential code) and performs a block wide arg-min reduction to\n//            select the next member.  Candidate sets are restricted to the\n//            points within `threshold` of the seed, which is exact: any point\n//            farther away can never be added because the seed itself is a\n//            cluster member.\n//   * MPI  : the seed points of a round are distributed round-robin over the\n//            ranks, each rank drives its own GPU, and the globally best seed\n//            is obtained with a single MAXLOC all-reduce.\n//   * OpenMP: host side work (spatial grid / neighbour list construction,\n//            reductions over per-seed cardinalities, bookkeeping, validation).\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                  \\\n    do {                                                                                  \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                  \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                        \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_),          \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                                  \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Block-wide arg-min over (distance, point index) with the same tie breaking as\n// the sequential code: the smallest point index wins for equal distances.\n__device__ inline void blockArgMin(double& bd, int& bi, double* sd, int* si) {\n    const unsigned mask = 0xffffffffu;\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double od = __shfl_down_sync(mask, bd, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(mask, bi, off);\n        if (od < bd || (od == bd && oi < bi)) {\n            bd = od;\n            bi = oi;\n        }\n    }\n\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    const int nwarps = (blockDim.x + 31) >> 5;\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        sd[warp] = bd;\n        si[warp] = bi;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        double b = sd[0];\n        int j = si[0];\n        for (int w = 1; w < nwarps; ++w) {\n            if (sd[w] < b || (sd[w] == b && si[w] < j)) {\n                b = sd[w];\n                j = si[w];\n            }\n        }\n        sd[0] = b;\n        si[0] = j;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    bd = sd[0];\n    bi = si[0];\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// One block grows the candidate cluster of one seed point.\n//   md2[] holds, per candidate, the maximum squared distance to any current\n//   cluster member (DBL_MAX marks \"not available\").  Because sqrt() is\n//   monotonic and correctly rounded, max(sqrt(d2)) == sqrt(max(d2)), so the\n//   selected point and the accepted/rejected decisions are bit-identical to the\n//   sequential formulation.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(256) void growClusterKernel(\n    const Point* __restrict__ pts, const long long* __restrict__ nbrOff,\n    const int* __restrict__ nbrList, const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n    const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int numSeeds, const double threshold,\n    int* __restrict__ card, int* __restrict__ membersOut, const int memberStride,\n    double* __restrict__ md2Global, const long long mdStride, const int useShared) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    const int seed = seeds[b];\n    const long long off = nbrOff[seed];\n    const int cnt = static_cast<int>(nbrOff[seed + 1] - off);\n\n    extern __shared__ char smem[];\n    __shared__ double sd[32];\n    __shared__ int si[32];\n\n    double* md;\n    int* cl;  // candidate point indices (shared copy), null for the global path\n    if (useShared) {\n        md = reinterpret_cast<double*>(smem);\n        cl = reinterpret_cast<int*>(md + cnt);\n    } else {\n        md = md2Global + static_cast<long long>(b) * mdStride;\n        cl = nullptr;\n    }\n\n    const Point sp = pts[seed];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int bs = blockDim.x;\n\n    for (int i = tid; i < cnt; i += bs) {\n        const int p = nbrList[off + i];\n        const Point q = pts[p];\n        const double dx = q.x - sp.x;\n        const double dy = q.y - sp.y;\n        md[i] = clustered[p] ? DBL_MAX : (dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        if (useShared) cl[i] = p;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int* mem = (membersOut != nullptr) ? membersOut + static_cast<long long>(b) * memberStride\n                                       : nullptr;\n    if (mem != nullptr && tid == 0) mem[0] = seed;\n    int nmem = 1;\n\n    while (true) {\n        double bd = DBL_MAX;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n\n        for (int i = tid; i < cnt; i += bs) {\n            const double m = md[i];\n            if (m == DBL_MAX) continue;\n            const double d = sqrt(m);\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                const int p = useShared ? cl[i] : nbrList[off + i];\n                if (d < bd || (d == bd && p < bi)) {\n                    bd = d;\n                    bi = p;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        blockArgMin(bd, bi, sd, si);\n        if (bi == INT_MAX) break;  // no admissible point left\n\n        if (mem != nullptr && tid == 0) mem[nmem] = bi;\n        ++nmem;\n\n        const Point w = pts[bi];\n        for (int i = tid; i < cnt; i += bs) {\n            const int p = useShared ? cl[i] : nbrList[off + i];\n            if (p == bi) {\n                md[i] = DBL_MAX;  // now a member of this cluster\n                continue;\n            }\n            const double m = md[i];\n            if (m == DBL_MAX) continue;\n            const double dx = pts[p].x - w.x;\n            const double dy = pts[p].y - w.y;\n            const double d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            md[i] = (d2 > m) ? d2 : m;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) card[b] = nmem;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Data generation (bit-identical to the sequential reference)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Neighbour lists (all points strictly closer than `threshold`), built once\n// with a uniform spatial grid.  OpenMP parallel.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic void buildNeighborLists(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold,\n                               std::vector<long long>& offsets, std::vector<int>& list) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    double minx = points[0].x, maxx = points[0].x;\n    double miny = points[0].y, maxy = points[0].y;\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(min : minx, miny) reduction(max : maxx, maxy) schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        minx = std::min(minx, points[i].x);\n        maxx = std::max(maxx, points[i].x);\n        miny = std::min(miny, points[i].y);\n        maxy = std::max(maxy, points[i].y);\n    }\n\n    const double cell = threshold;\n    const int nx = std::max(1, static_cast<int>((maxx - minx) / cell) + 1);\n    const int ny = std::max(1, static_cast<int>((maxy - miny) / cell) + 1);\n    const long long ncells = static_cast<long long>(nx) * ny;\n\n    std::vector<int> cellOf(N);\n    std::vector<int> cellStart(ncells + 1, 0);\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        int cx = static_cast<int>((points[i].x - minx) / cell);\n        int cy = static_cast<int>((points[i].y - miny) / cell);\n        cx = std::min(std::max(cx, 0), nx - 1);\n        cy = std::min(std::max(cy, 0), ny - 1);\n        const int c = cy * nx + cx;\n        cellOf[i] = c;\n#pragma omp atomic\n        cellStart[c + 1]++;\n    }\n    for (long long c = 0; c < ncells; ++c) cellStart[c + 1] += cellStart[c];\n\n    std::vector<int> cellPts(N);\n    {\n        std::vector<int> cursor(cellStart.begin(), cellStart.end() - 1);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            int slot;\n            const int c = cellOf[i];\n#pragma omp atomic capture\n            slot = cursor[c]++;\n            cellPts[slot] = i;\n        }\n        // Keep each cell's point list ascending for cache/coalescing friendliness.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n        for (long long c = 0; c < ncells; ++c) {\n            std::sort(cellPts.begin() + cellStart[c], cellPts.begin() + cellStart[c + 1]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    offsets.assign(N + 1, 0);\n\n    // Pass 1: count\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const int cx = cellOf[i] % nx;\n        const int cy = cellOf[i] / nx;\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int gy = std::max(cy - 1, 0); gy <= std::min(cy + 1, ny - 1); ++gy) {\n            for (int gx = std::max(cx - 1, 0); gx <= std::min(cx + 1, nx - 1); ++gx) {\n                const int c = gy * nx + gx;\n                for (int k = cellStart[c]; k < cellStart[c + 1]; ++k) {\n                    const int j = cellPts[k];\n                    if (j == i) continue;\n                    if (distance(points[i], points[j]) < threshold) ++cnt;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        offsets[i + 1] = cnt;\n    }\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) offsets[i + 1] += offsets[i];\n\n    list.resize(static_cast<size_t>(offsets[N]));\n\n    // Pass 2: fill\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const int cx = cellOf[i] % nx;\n        const int cy = cellOf[i] / nx;\n        long long w = offsets[i];\n        for (int gy = std::max(cy - 1, 0); gy <= std::min(cy + 1, ny - 1); ++gy) {\n            for (int gx = std::max(cx - 1, 0); gx <= std::min(cx + 1, nx - 1); ++gx) {\n                const int c = gy * nx + gx;\n                for (int k = cellStart[c]; k < cellStart[c + 1]; ++k) {\n                    const int j = cellPts[k];\n                    if (j == i) continue;\n                    if (distance(points[i], points[j]) < threshold) list[w++] = j;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GpuState {\n    Point* d_pts = nullptr;\n    long long* d_off = nullptr;\n    int* d_list = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr;\n    double* d_md2 = nullptr;\n    long long mdStride = 0;\n    int maxGlobalBlocks = 0;\n};\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold,\n                                  const int mpi_rank, const int mpi_size) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    std::vector<long long> offsets;\n    std::vector<int> nbrList;\n    buildNeighborLists(points, threshold, offsets, nbrList);\n\n    // Per point neighbour counts drive the block size / shared memory decisions.\n    int maxCnt = 0;\n    long long sumCnt = 0;\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(max : maxCnt) reduction(+ : sumCnt) schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const int c = static_cast<int>(offsets[i + 1] - offsets[i]);\n        maxCnt = std::max(maxCnt, c);\n        sumCnt += c;\n    }\n    const int avgCnt = static_cast<int>(sumCnt / std::max(N, 1));\n\n    // Block size: enough threads to cover a typical candidate set, capped at 256.\n    int blockSize = 32;\n    while (blockSize < 256 && blockSize < avgCnt) blockSize <<= 1;\n\n    // Shared memory budget per block (12 bytes per candidate: md2 + index).\n    const int sharedCapBytes = 32 * 1024;\n    const int sharedCapCnt = sharedCapBytes / 12;\n\n    GpuState g;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_pts, sizeof(Point) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_off, sizeof(long long) * (N + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_list, sizeof(int) * std::max<size_t>(nbrList.size(), 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_clustered, N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_seeds, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_card, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_members, sizeof(int) * (maxCnt + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_pts, points.data(), sizeof(Point) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_off, offsets.data(), sizeof(long long) * (N + 1),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!nbrList.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_list, nbrList.data(), sizeof(int) * nbrList.size(),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    // Scratch for seeds whose candidate set does not fit into shared memory.\n    if (maxCnt > sharedCapCnt) {\n        const size_t budget = 512ull * 1024ull * 1024ull;\n        g.mdStride = maxCnt;\n        g.maxGlobalBlocks =\n            static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, budget / (sizeof(double) * g.mdStride)));\n        g.maxGlobalBlocks = std::min(g.maxGlobalBlocks, N);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_md2, sizeof(double) * g.mdStride * g.maxGlobalBlocks));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(growClusterKernel,\n                                    cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, sharedCapBytes));\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered[i] = i;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    std::vector<int> seedsSmall, seedsBig, cards;\n    seedsSmall.reserve(N);\n    seedsBig.reserve(N);\n    cards.resize(N);\n    std::vector<int> winnerMembers(maxCnt + 1);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    while (!unclustered.empty()) {\n        // Round-robin distribution of this round's seeds over the ranks.\n        seedsSmall.clear();\n        seedsBig.clear();\n        int maxSmallCnt = 1;\n        for (size_t i = mpi_rank; i < unclustered.size(); i += mpi_size) {\n            const int s = unclustered[i];\n            const int c = static_cast<int>(offsets[s + 1] - offsets[s]);\n            if (c <= sharedCapCnt) {\n                seedsSmall.push_back(s);\n                maxSmallCnt = std::max(maxSmallCnt, c);\n            } else {\n                seedsBig.push_back(s);\n            }\n        }\n        // Only request as much shared memory as the largest candidate set of\n        // this round actually needs - this directly drives GPU occupancy.\n        const int smallShBytes = 12 * maxSmallCnt;\n\n        const int nSmall = static_cast<int>(seedsSmall.size());\n        const int nBig = static_cast<int>(seedsBig.size());\n        const int nLocal = nSmall + nBig;\n\n        if (nSmall > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds, seedsSmall.data(), sizeof(int) * nSmall,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            growClusterKernel<<<nSmall, blockSize, smallShBytes>>>(\n                g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds, nSmall, threshold, g.d_card,\n                nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, 1);\n        }\n        if (nBig > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds + nSmall, seedsBig.data(), sizeof(int) * nBig,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            for (int base = 0; base < nBig; base += g.maxGlobalBlocks) {\n                const int nb = std::min(g.maxGlobalBlocks, nBig - base);\n                growClusterKernel<<<nb, blockSize, 0>>>(\n                    g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds + nSmall + base, nb,\n                    threshold, g.d_card + nSmall + base, nullptr, 0, g.d_md2, g.mdStride, 0);\n            }\n        }\n        if (nLocal > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cards.data(), g.d_card, sizeof(int) * nLocal,\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        // Local best: maximum cardinality, smallest seed index on ties.\n        int bestCard = -1;\n        int bestSeed = INT_MAX;\n#pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            int lc = -1, ls = INT_MAX;\n#pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < nLocal; ++i) {\n                const int s = (i < nSmall) ? seedsSmall[i] : seedsBig[i - nSmall];\n                const int c = cards[i];\n                if (c > lc || (c == lc && s < ls)) {\n                    lc = c;\n                    ls = s;\n                }\n            }\n#pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lc > bestCard || (lc == bestCard && ls < bestSeed)) {\n                    bestCard = lc;\n                    bestSeed = ls;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global reduction: MPI_MAXLOC yields max cardinality with the smallest\n        // seed index among ties - exactly the sequential selection rule.\n        struct {\n            int card;\n            int seed;\n        } in, out;\n        in.card = bestCard;\n        in.seed = (bestSeed == INT_MAX) ? INT_MAX : bestSeed;\n        MPI_Allreduce(&in, &out, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (out.card <= 0) break;  // no more clusters can be formed\n\n        // Re-grow the winning cluster (single block) on every rank so that all\n        // ranks stay in sync without communicating the member list.\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds, &out.seed, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        const int wcnt = static_cast<int>(offsets[out.seed + 1] - offsets[out.seed]);\n        if (wcnt <= sharedCapCnt) {\n            growClusterKernel<<<1, blockSize, sharedCapBytes>>>(\n                g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds, 1, threshold, g.d_card,\n                g.d_members, maxCnt + 1, nullptr, 0, 1);\n        } else {\n            growClusterKernel<<<1, blockSize, 0>>>(g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered,\n                                                   g.d_seeds, 1, threshold, g.d_card, g.d_members,\n                                                   maxCnt + 1, g.d_md2, g.mdStride, 0);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(winnerMembers.data(), g.d_members, sizeof(int) * out.card,\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = out.seed;\n        cluster.members.assign(winnerMembers.begin(), winnerMembers.begin() + out.card);\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < out.card; ++i) clustered[cluster.members[i]] = 1;\n\n        unclustered.erase(std::remove_if(unclustered.begin(), unclustered.end(),\n                                         [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                          unclustered.end());\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    cudaFree(g.d_pts);\n    cudaFree(g.d_off);\n    cudaFree(g.d_list);\n    cudaFree(g.d_clustered);\n    cudaFree(g.d_seeds);\n    cudaFree(g.d_card);\n    cudaFree(g.d_members);\n    if (g.d_md2) cudaFree(g.d_md2);\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters, const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                      const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    const int nc = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(nc, 0.0);\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist =\n                    distance(points[cluster.members[i]], points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        if (c < 10) {  // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", c,\n                   clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, diameters[c]);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (diameters[c] > threshold * 1.001) {  // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", c, diameters[c],\n                   threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %d)\\n\", member,\n                       membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = c;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\", points.size(), clustered_count,\n           points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: Every candidate cluster is grown by one\n//            thread block; the block keeps an incremental \"max distance to any\n//            current member\" value per candidate point (max is associative, so\n//            this is mathematically identical to the O(k) rescan of the\n//            sequential code) and performs a block wide arg-min reduction to\n//            select the next member.  Candidate sets are restricted to the\n//            points within `threshold` of the seed, which is exact: any point\n//            farther away can never be added because the seed itself is a\n//            cluster member.\n//   * MPI  : the seed points of a round are distributed round-robin over the\n//            ranks, each rank drives its own GPU, and the globally best seed\n//            is obtained with a single MAXLOC all-reduce.\n//   * OpenMP: host side work (spatial grid / neighbour list construction,\n//            reductions over per-seed cardinalities, bookkeeping, validation).\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cfloat>\n#include <climits>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <limits>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nstatic const double MAX_WIDTH = 20.0;\nstatic const double MAX_HEIGHT = 20.0;\n\n// Structure to represent a point in 2D space\nstruct Point {\n    double x, y;\n};\n\n// Structure to represent a cluster\nstruct Cluster {\n    std::vector<int> members;\n    int seed_point;\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// CUDA helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                  \\\n    do {                                                                                  \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                  \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                        \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(err_),          \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                                  \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Block-wide arg-min over (distance, point index) with the same tie breaking as\n// the sequential code: the smallest point index wins for equal distances.\n__device__ inline void blockArgMin(double& bd, int& bi, double* sd, int* si) {\n    const unsigned mask = 0xffffffffu;\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double od = __shfl_down_sync(mask, bd, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(mask, bi, off);\n        if (od < bd || (od == bd && oi < bi)) {\n            bd = od;\n            bi = oi;\n        }\n    }\n\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    const int nwarps = (blockDim.x + 31) >> 5;\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        sd[warp] = bd;\n        si[warp] = bi;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        double b = sd[0];\n        int j = si[0];\n        for (int w = 1; w < nwarps; ++w) {\n            if (sd[w] < b || (sd[w] == b && si[w] < j)) {\n                b = sd[w];\n                j = si[w];\n            }\n        }\n        sd[0] = b;\n        si[0] = j;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    bd = sd[0];\n    bi = si[0];\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// One block grows the candidate cluster of one seed point.\n//   md2[] holds, per candidate, the maximum squared distance to any current\n//   cluster member (DBL_MAX marks \"not available\").  Because sqrt() is\n//   monotonic and correctly rounded, max(sqrt(d2)) == sqrt(max(d2)), so the\n//   selected point and the accepted/rejected decisions are bit-identical to the\n//   sequential formulation.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(256) void growClusterKernel(\n    const Point* __restrict__ pts, const long long* __restrict__ nbrOff,\n    const int* __restrict__ nbrList, const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n    const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int numSeeds, const double threshold,\n    int* __restrict__ card, int* __restrict__ membersOut, const int memberStride,\n    double* __restrict__ md2Global, const long long mdStride, const int useShared) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    const int seed = seeds[b];\n    const long long off = nbrOff[seed];\n    const int cnt = static_cast<int>(nbrOff[seed + 1] - off);\n\n    extern __shared__ char smem[];\n    __shared__ double sd[32];\n    __shared__ int si[32];\n\n    double* md;\n    int* cl;  // candidate point indices (shared copy), null for the global path\n    if (useShared) {\n        md = reinterpret_cast<double*>(smem);\n        cl = reinterpret_cast<int*>(md + cnt);\n    } else {\n        md = md2Global + static_cast<long long>(b) * mdStride;\n        cl = nullptr;\n    }\n\n    const Point sp = pts[seed];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int bs = blockDim.x;\n\n    for (int i = tid; i < cnt; i += bs) {\n        const int p = nbrList[off + i];\n        const Point q = pts[p];\n        const double dx = q.x - sp.x;\n        const double dy = q.y - sp.y;\n        md[i] = clustered[p] ? DBL_MAX : (dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        if (useShared) cl[i] = p;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int* mem = (membersOut != nullptr) ? membersOut + static_cast<long long>(b) * memberStride\n                                       : nullptr;\n    if (mem != nullptr && tid == 0) mem[0] = seed;\n    int nmem = 1;\n\n    while (true) {\n        double bd = DBL_MAX;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n\n        for (int i = tid; i < cnt; i += bs) {\n            const double m = md[i];\n            if (m == DBL_MAX) continue;\n            const double d = sqrt(m);\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                const int p = useShared ? cl[i] : nbrList[off + i];\n                if (d < bd || (d == bd && p < bi)) {\n                    bd = d;\n                    bi = p;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        blockArgMin(bd, bi, sd, si);\n        if (bi == INT_MAX) break;  // no admissible point left\n\n        if (mem != nullptr && tid == 0) mem[nmem] = bi;\n        ++nmem;\n\n        const Point w = pts[bi];\n        for (int i = tid; i < cnt; i += bs) {\n            const int p = useShared ? cl[i] : nbrList[off + i];\n            if (p == bi) {\n                md[i] = DBL_MAX;  // now a member of this cluster\n                continue;\n            }\n            const double m = md[i];\n            if (m == DBL_MAX) continue;\n            const double dx = pts[p].x - w.x;\n            const double dy = pts[p].y - w.y;\n            const double d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            md[i] = (d2 > m) ? d2 : m;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) card[b] = nmem;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Data generation (bit-identical to the sequential reference)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Neighbour lists (all points strictly closer than `threshold`), built once\n// with a uniform spatial grid.  OpenMP parallel.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic void buildNeighborLists(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold,\n                               std::vector<long long>& offsets, std::vector<int>& list) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    double minx = points[0].x, maxx = points[0].x;\n    double miny = points[0].y, maxy = points[0].y;\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(min : minx, miny) reduction(max : maxx, maxy) schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        minx = std::min(minx, points[i].x);\n        maxx = std::max(maxx, points[i].x);\n        miny = std::min(miny, points[i].y);\n        maxy = std::max(maxy, points[i].y);\n    }\n\n    const double cell = threshold;\n    const int nx = std::max(1, static_cast<int>((maxx - minx) / cell) + 1);\n    const int ny = std::max(1, static_cast<int>((maxy - miny) / cell) + 1);\n    const long long ncells = static_cast<long long>(nx) * ny;\n\n    std::vector<int> cellOf(N);\n    std::vector<int> cellStart(ncells + 1, 0);\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        int cx = static_cast<int>((points[i].x - minx) / cell);\n        int cy = static_cast<int>((points[i].y - miny) / cell);\n        cx = std::min(std::max(cx, 0), nx - 1);\n        cy = std::min(std::max(cy, 0), ny - 1);\n        const int c = cy * nx + cx;\n        cellOf[i] = c;\n#pragma omp atomic\n        cellStart[c + 1]++;\n    }\n    for (long long c = 0; c < ncells; ++c) cellStart[c + 1] += cellStart[c];\n\n    std::vector<int> cellPts(N);\n    {\n        std::vector<int> cursor(cellStart.begin(), cellStart.end() - 1);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            int slot;\n            const int c = cellOf[i];\n#pragma omp atomic capture\n            slot = cursor[c]++;\n            cellPts[slot] = i;\n        }\n        // Keep each cell's point list ascending for cache/coalescing friendliness.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n        for (long long c = 0; c < ncells; ++c) {\n            std::sort(cellPts.begin() + cellStart[c], cellPts.begin() + cellStart[c + 1]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    offsets.assign(N + 1, 0);\n\n    // Pass 1: count\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const int cx = cellOf[i] % nx;\n        const int cy = cellOf[i] / nx;\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int gy = std::max(cy - 1, 0); gy <= std::min(cy + 1, ny - 1); ++gy) {\n            for (int gx = std::max(cx - 1, 0); gx <= std::min(cx + 1, nx - 1); ++gx) {\n                const int c = gy * nx + gx;\n                for (int k = cellStart[c]; k < cellStart[c + 1]; ++k) {\n                    const int j = cellPts[k];\n                    if (j == i) continue;\n                    if (distance(points[i], points[j]) < threshold) ++cnt;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        offsets[i + 1] = cnt;\n    }\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) offsets[i + 1] += offsets[i];\n\n    list.resize(static_cast<size_t>(offsets[N]));\n\n    // Pass 2: fill\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const int cx = cellOf[i] % nx;\n        const int cy = cellOf[i] / nx;\n        long long w = offsets[i];\n        for (int gy = std::max(cy - 1, 0); gy <= std::min(cy + 1, ny - 1); ++gy) {\n            for (int gx = std::max(cx - 1, 0); gx <= std::min(cx + 1, nx - 1); ++gx) {\n                const int c = gy * nx + gx;\n                for (int k = cellStart[c]; k < cellStart[c + 1]; ++k) {\n                    const int j = cellPts[k];\n                    if (j == i) continue;\n                    if (distance(points[i], points[j]) < threshold) list[w++] = j;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GpuState {\n    Point* d_pts = nullptr;\n    long long* d_off = nullptr;\n    int* d_list = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr;\n    double* d_md2 = nullptr;\n    long long mdStride = 0;\n    int maxGlobalBlocks = 0;\n};\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold,\n                                  const int mpi_rank, const int mpi_size) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    std::vector<long long> offsets;\n    std::vector<int> nbrList;\n    buildNeighborLists(points, threshold, offsets, nbrList);\n\n    // Per point neighbour counts drive the block size / shared memory decisions.\n    int maxCnt = 0;\n    long long sumCnt = 0;\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(max : maxCnt) reduction(+ : sumCnt) schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const int c = static_cast<int>(offsets[i + 1] - offsets[i]);\n        maxCnt = std::max(maxCnt, c);\n        sumCnt += c;\n    }\n    const int avgCnt = static_cast<int>(sumCnt / std::max(N, 1));\n\n    // Block size: enough threads to cover a typical candidate set, capped at 256.\n    int blockSize = 32;\n    while (blockSize < 256 && blockSize < avgCnt) blockSize <<= 1;\n\n    // Shared memory budget per block (12 bytes per candidate: md2 + index).\n    const int sharedCapBytes = 32 * 1024;\n    const int sharedCapCnt = sharedCapBytes / 12;\n\n    GpuState g;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_pts, sizeof(Point) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_off, sizeof(long long) * (N + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_list, sizeof(int) * std::max<size_t>(nbrList.size(), 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_clustered, N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_seeds, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_card, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_members, sizeof(int) * (maxCnt + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_pts, points.data(), sizeof(Point) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_off, offsets.data(), sizeof(long long) * (N + 1),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!nbrList.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_list, nbrList.data(), sizeof(int) * nbrList.size(),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    // Scratch for seeds whose candidate set does not fit into shared memory.\n    if (maxCnt > sharedCapCnt) {\n        const size_t budget = 512ull * 1024ull * 1024ull;\n        g.mdStride = maxCnt;\n        g.maxGlobalBlocks =\n            static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, budget / (sizeof(double) * g.mdStride)));\n        g.maxGlobalBlocks = std::min(g.maxGlobalBlocks, N);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_md2, sizeof(double) * g.mdStride * g.maxGlobalBlocks));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(growClusterKernel,\n                                    cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, sharedCapBytes));\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered[i] = i;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    std::vector<int> seedsSmall, seedsBig, cards;\n    seedsSmall.reserve(N);\n    seedsBig.reserve(N);\n    cards.resize(N);\n    std::vector<int> winnerMembers(maxCnt + 1);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    while (!unclustered.empty()) {\n        // Round-robin distribution of this round's seeds over the ranks.\n        seedsSmall.clear();\n        seedsBig.clear();\n        int maxSmallCnt = 1;\n        for (size_t i = mpi_rank; i < unclustered.size(); i += mpi_size) {\n            const int s = unclustered[i];\n            const int c = static_cast<int>(offsets[s + 1] - offsets[s]);\n            if (c <= sharedCapCnt) {\n                seedsSmall.push_back(s);\n                maxSmallCnt = std::max(maxSmallCnt, c);\n            } else {\n                seedsBig.push_back(s);\n            }\n        }\n        // Only request as much shared memory as the largest candidate set of\n        // this round actually needs - this directly drives GPU occupancy.\n        const int smallShBytes = 12 * maxSmallCnt;\n\n        const int nSmall = static_cast<int>(seedsSmall.size());\n        const int nBig = static_cast<int>(seedsBig.size());\n        const int nLocal = nSmall + nBig;\n\n        if (nSmall > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds, seedsSmall.data(), sizeof(int) * nSmall,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            growClusterKernel<<<nSmall, blockSize, smallShBytes>>>(\n                g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds, nSmall, threshold, g.d_card,\n                nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, 1);\n        }\n        if (nBig > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds + nSmall, seedsBig.data(), sizeof(int) * nBig,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            for (int base = 0; base < nBig; base += g.maxGlobalBlocks) {\n                const int nb = std::min(g.maxGlobalBlocks, nBig - base);\n                growClusterKernel<<<nb, blockSize, 0>>>(\n                    g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds + nSmall + base, nb,\n                    threshold, g.d_card + nSmall + base, nullptr, 0, g.d_md2, g.mdStride, 0);\n            }\n        }\n        if (nLocal > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cards.data(), g.d_card, sizeof(int) * nLocal,\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        // Local best: maximum cardinality, smallest seed index on ties.\n        int bestCard = -1;\n        int bestSeed = INT_MAX;\n#pragma omp parallel\n        {\n            int lc = -1, ls = INT_MAX;\n#pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < nLocal; ++i) {\n                const int s = (i < nSmall) ? seedsSmall[i] : seedsBig[i - nSmall];\n                const int c = cards[i];\n                if (c > lc || (c == lc && s < ls)) {\n                    lc = c;\n                    ls = s;\n                }\n            }\n#pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lc > bestCard || (lc == bestCard && ls < bestSeed)) {\n                    bestCard = lc;\n                    bestSeed = ls;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global reduction: MPI_MAXLOC yields max cardinality with the smallest\n        // seed index among ties - exactly the sequential selection rule.\n        struct {\n            int card;\n            int seed;\n        } in, out;\n        in.card = bestCard;\n        in.seed = (bestSeed == INT_MAX) ? INT_MAX : bestSeed;\n        MPI_Allreduce(&in, &out, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (out.card <= 0) break;  // no more clusters can be formed\n\n        // Re-grow the winning cluster (single block) on every rank so that all\n        // ranks stay in sync without communicating the member list.\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds, &out.seed, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        const int wcnt = static_cast<int>(offsets[out.seed + 1] - offsets[out.seed]);\n        if (wcnt <= sharedCapCnt) {\n            growClusterKernel<<<1, blockSize, 12 * std::max(wcnt, 1)>>>(\n                g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds, 1, threshold, g.d_card,\n                g.d_members, maxCnt + 1, nullptr, 0, 1);\n        } else {\n            growClusterKernel<<<1, blockSize, 0>>>(g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered,\n                                                   g.d_seeds, 1, threshold, g.d_card, g.d_members,\n                                                   maxCnt + 1, g.d_md2, g.mdStride, 0);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(winnerMembers.data(), g.d_members, sizeof(int) * out.card,\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = out.seed;\n        cluster.members.assign(winnerMembers.begin(), winnerMembers.begin() + out.card);\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < out.card; ++i) clustered[cluster.members[i]] = 1;\n\n        unclustered.erase(std::remove_if(unclustered.begin(), unclustered.end(),\n                                         [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                          unclustered.end());\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    cudaFree(g.d_pts);\n    cudaFree(g.d_off);\n    cudaFree(g.d_list);\n    cudaFree(g.d_clustered);\n    cudaFree(g.d_seeds);\n    cudaFree(g.d_card);\n    cudaFree(g.d_members);\n    if (g.d_md2) cudaFree(g.d_md2);\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters, const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                      const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    const int nc = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(nc, 0.0);\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist =\n                    distance(points[cluster.members[i]], points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        if (c < 10) {  // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", c,\n                   clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, diameters[c]);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (diameters[c] > threshold * 1.001) {  // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", c, diameters[c],\n                   threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %d)\\n\", member,\n                       membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = c;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\", points.size(), clustered_count,\n           points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default:                                                  \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                 \\\n        }                                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// Block-wide arg-min over (distance, point index) with the same tie breaking as\n// the sequential code: the smallest point index wins for equal distances.\n__device__ inline void blockArgMin(double& bd, int& bi, double* sd, int* si) {\n    const unsigned mask = 0xffffffffu;\n    for (int off = 16; off > 0; off >>= 1) {\n        const double od = __shfl_down_sync(mask, bd, off);\n        const int oi = __shfl_down_sync(mask, bi, off);\n        if (od < bd || (od == bd && oi < bi)) {\n            bd = od;\n            bi = oi;\n        }\n    }\n\n    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31;\n    const int warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;\n    const int nwarps = (blockDim.x + 31) >> 5;\n\n    if (lane == 0) {\n        sd[warp] = bd;\n        si[warp] = bi;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    if (threadIdx.x == 0) {\n        double b = sd[0];\n        int j = si[0];\n        for (int w = 1; w < nwarps; ++w) {\n            if (sd[w] < b || (sd[w] == b && si[w] < j)) {\n                b = sd[w];\n                j = si[w];\n            }\n        }\n        sd[0] = b;\n        si[0] = j;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    bd = sd[0];\n    bi = si[0];\n    __syncthreads();\n}\n\n// One block grows the candidate cluster of one seed point.\n//   md2[] holds, per candidate, the maximum squared distance to any current\n//   cluster member (DBL_MAX marks \"not available\").  Because sqrt() is\n//   monotonic and correctly rounded, max(sqrt(d2)) == sqrt(max(d2)), so the\n//   selected point and the accepted/rejected decisions are bit-identical to the\n//   sequential formulation.\n__global__ __launch_bounds__(256) void growClusterKernel(\n    const Point* __restrict__ pts, const long long* __restrict__ nbrOff,\n    const int* __restrict__ nbrList, const unsigned char* __restrict__ clustered,\n    const int* __restrict__ seeds, const int numSeeds, const double threshold,\n    int* __restrict__ card, int* __restrict__ membersOut, const int memberStride,\n    double* __restrict__ md2Global, const long long mdStride, const int useShared) {\n    const int b = blockIdx.x;\n    if (b >= numSeeds) return;\n\n    const int seed = seeds[b];\n    const long long off = nbrOff[seed];\n    const int cnt = static_cast<int>(nbrOff[seed + 1] - off);\n\n    extern __shared__ char smem[];\n    __shared__ double sd[32];\n    __shared__ int si[32];\n\n    double* md;\n    int* cl;  // candidate point indices (shared copy), null for the global path\n    if (useShared) {\n        md = reinterpret_cast<double*>(smem);\n        cl = reinterpret_cast<int*>(md + cnt);\n    } else {\n        md = md2Global + static_cast<long long>(b) * mdStride;\n        cl = nullptr;\n    }\n\n    const Point sp = pts[seed];\n    const int tid = threadIdx.x;\n    const int bs = blockDim.x;\n\n    for (int i = tid; i < cnt; i += bs) {\n        const int p = nbrList[off + i];\n        const Point q = pts[p];\n        const double dx = q.x - sp.x;\n        const double dy = q.y - sp.y;\n        md[i] = clustered[p] ? DBL_MAX : (dx * dx + dy * dy);\n        if (useShared) cl[i] = p;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    int* mem = (membersOut != nullptr) ? membersOut + static_cast<long long>(b) * memberStride\n                                       : nullptr;\n    if (mem != nullptr && tid == 0) mem[0] = seed;\n    int nmem = 1;\n\n    while (true) {\n        double bd = DBL_MAX;\n        int bi = INT_MAX;\n\n        for (int i = tid; i < cnt; i += bs) {\n            const double m = md[i];\n            if (m == DBL_MAX) continue;\n            const double d = sqrt(m);\n            if (d < threshold) {\n                const int p = useShared ? cl[i] : nbrList[off + i];\n                if (d < bd || (d == bd && p < bi)) {\n                    bd = d;\n                    bi = p;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        blockArgMin(bd, bi, sd, si);\n        if (bi == INT_MAX) break;  // no admissible point left\n\n        if (mem != nullptr && tid == 0) mem[nmem] = bi;\n        ++nmem;\n\n        const Point w = pts[bi];\n        for (int i = tid; i < cnt; i += bs) {\n            const int p = useShared ? cl[i] : nbrList[off + i];\n            if (p == bi) {\n                md[i] = DBL_MAX;  // now a member of this cluster\n                continue;\n            }\n            const double m = md[i];\n            if (m == DBL_MAX) continue;\n            const double dx = pts[p].x - w.x;\n            const double dy = pts[p].y - w.y;\n            const double d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;\n            md[i] = (d2 > m) ? d2 : m;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (tid == 0) card[b] = nmem;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Data generation (bit-identical to the sequential reference)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nvoid generateSyntheticData(std::vector<Point>& points, const int N, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    auto frand = [&seed]() mutable { return rand_r(&seed) / static_cast<double>(RAND_MAX); };\n\n    const double min_dim = std::min(MAX_WIDTH, MAX_HEIGHT);\n    int count = 0;\n\n    while (count < N) {\n        // Create group_cnt points within a circle of radius R\n        // around center point (cntr_x, cntr_y)\n        const double cntr_x = frand() * MAX_WIDTH;\n        const double cntr_y = frand() * MAX_HEIGHT;\n        const double R = frand() * min_dim / 2.0;\n        int group_cnt = static_cast<int>(frand() * (N / 30.0));\n\n        // Make sure we don't make more points than we need\n        if (group_cnt > (N - count)) {\n            group_cnt = N - count;\n        }\n\n        while (group_cnt > 0) {\n            const double sign = (frand() < 0.5) ? -1.0 : 1.0;\n            const double r = frand() * R;\n            const double dx = (2.0 * frand() - 1.0) * r;\n            const double dy = std::sqrt(r * r - dx * dx) * sign;\n            const double x = cntr_x + dx;\n            const double y = cntr_y + dy;\n\n            if (x < 0 || x > MAX_WIDTH || y < 0 || y > MAX_HEIGHT) {\n                continue;\n            }\n\n            points[count] = {x, y};\n            count++;\n            group_cnt--;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Calculate Euclidean distance between two points\ninline double distance(const Point& p1, const Point& p2) {\n    double dx = p1.x - p2.x;\n    double dy = p1.y - p2.y;\n    return std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Neighbour lists (all points strictly closer than `threshold`), built once\n// with a uniform spatial grid.  OpenMP parallel.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstatic void buildNeighborLists(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold,\n                               std::vector<long long>& offsets, std::vector<int>& list) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    double minx = points[0].x, maxx = points[0].x;\n    double miny = points[0].y, maxy = points[0].y;\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(min : minx, miny) reduction(max : maxx, maxy) schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        minx = std::min(minx, points[i].x);\n        maxx = std::max(maxx, points[i].x);\n        miny = std::min(miny, points[i].y);\n        maxy = std::max(maxy, points[i].y);\n    }\n\n    const double cell = threshold;\n    const int nx = std::max(1, static_cast<int>((maxx - minx) / cell) + 1);\n    const int ny = std::max(1, static_cast<int>((maxy - miny) / cell) + 1);\n    const long long ncells = static_cast<long long>(nx) * ny;\n\n    std::vector<int> cellOf(N);\n    std::vector<int> cellStart(ncells + 1, 0);\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        int cx = static_cast<int>((points[i].x - minx) / cell);\n        int cy = static_cast<int>((points[i].y - miny) / cell);\n        cx = std::min(std::max(cx, 0), nx - 1);\n        cy = std::min(std::max(cy, 0), ny - 1);\n        const int c = cy * nx + cx;\n        cellOf[i] = c;\n#pragma omp atomic\n        cellStart[c + 1]++;\n    }\n    for (long long c = 0; c < ncells; ++c) cellStart[c + 1] += cellStart[c];\n\n    std::vector<int> cellPts(N);\n    {\n        std::vector<int> cursor(cellStart.begin(), cellStart.end() - 1);\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n            int slot;\n            const int c = cellOf[i];\n#pragma omp atomic capture\n            slot = cursor[c]++;\n            cellPts[slot] = i;\n        }\n        // Keep each cell's point list ascending for cache/coalescing friendliness.\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n        for (long long c = 0; c < ncells; ++c) {\n            std::sort(cellPts.begin() + cellStart[c], cellPts.begin() + cellStart[c + 1]);\n        }\n    }\n\n    offsets.assign(N + 1, 0);\n\n    // Pass 1: count\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const int cx = cellOf[i] % nx;\n        const int cy = cellOf[i] / nx;\n        int cnt = 0;\n        for (int gy = std::max(cy - 1, 0); gy <= std::min(cy + 1, ny - 1); ++gy) {\n            for (int gx = std::max(cx - 1, 0); gx <= std::min(cx + 1, nx - 1); ++gx) {\n                const int c = gy * nx + gx;\n                for (int k = cellStart[c]; k < cellStart[c + 1]; ++k) {\n                    const int j = cellPts[k];\n                    if (j == i) continue;\n                    if (distance(points[i], points[j]) < threshold) ++cnt;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        offsets[i + 1] = cnt;\n    }\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) offsets[i + 1] += offsets[i];\n\n    list.resize(static_cast<size_t>(offsets[N]));\n\n    // Pass 2: fill\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const int cx = cellOf[i] % nx;\n        const int cy = cellOf[i] / nx;\n        long long w = offsets[i];\n        for (int gy = std::max(cy - 1, 0); gy <= std::min(cy + 1, ny - 1); ++gy) {\n            for (int gx = std::max(cx - 1, 0); gx <= std::min(cx + 1, nx - 1); ++gx) {\n                const int c = gy * nx + gx;\n                for (int k = cellStart[c]; k < cellStart[c + 1]; ++k) {\n                    const int j = cellPts[k];\n                    if (j == i) continue;\n                    if (distance(points[i], points[j]) < threshold) list[w++] = j;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Main QT clustering algorithm (hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct GpuState {\n    Point* d_pts = nullptr;\n    long long* d_off = nullptr;\n    int* d_list = nullptr;\n    unsigned char* d_clustered = nullptr;\n    int* d_seeds = nullptr;\n    int* d_card = nullptr;\n    int* d_members = nullptr;\n    double* d_md2 = nullptr;\n    long long mdStride = 0;\n    int maxGlobalBlocks = 0;\n};\n\nstd::vector<Cluster> qtClustering(const std::vector<Point>& points, const double threshold,\n                                  const int mpi_rank, const int mpi_size) {\n    const int N = static_cast<int>(points.size());\n\n    std::vector<long long> offsets;\n    std::vector<int> nbrList;\n    buildNeighborLists(points, threshold, offsets, nbrList);\n\n    // Per point neighbour counts drive the block size / shared memory decisions.\n    int maxCnt = 0;\n    long long sumCnt = 0;\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(max : maxCnt) reduction(+ : sumCnt) schedule(static)\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const int c = static_cast<int>(offsets[i + 1] - offsets[i]);\n        maxCnt = std::max(maxCnt, c);\n        sumCnt += c;\n    }\n    const int avgCnt = static_cast<int>(sumCnt / std::max(N, 1));\n\n    // Block size: enough threads to cover a typical candidate set, capped at 256.\n    int blockSize = 32;\n    while (blockSize < 256 && blockSize < avgCnt) blockSize <<= 1;\n\n    // Shared memory budget per block (12 bytes per candidate: md2 + index).\n    const int sharedCapBytes = 32 * 1024;\n    const int sharedCapCnt = sharedCapBytes / 12;\n\n    GpuState g;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_pts, sizeof(Point) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_off, sizeof(long long) * (N + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_list, sizeof(int) * std::max<size_t>(nbrList.size(), 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_clustered, N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_seeds, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_card, sizeof(int) * N));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_members, sizeof(int) * (maxCnt + 1)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_pts, points.data(), sizeof(Point) * N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_off, offsets.data(), sizeof(long long) * (N + 1),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    if (!nbrList.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_list, nbrList.data(), sizeof(int) * nbrList.size(),\n                              cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    // Scratch for seeds whose candidate set does not fit into shared memory.\n    if (maxCnt > sharedCapCnt) {\n        const size_t budget = 512ull * 1024ull * 1024ull;\n        g.mdStride = maxCnt;\n        g.maxGlobalBlocks =\n            static_cast<int>(std::max<size_t>(1, budget / (sizeof(double) * g.mdStride)));\n        g.maxGlobalBlocks = std::min(g.maxGlobalBlocks, N);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&g.d_md2, sizeof(double) * g.mdStride * g.maxGlobalBlocks));\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFuncSetAttribute(growClusterKernel,\n                                    cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, sharedCapBytes));\n\n    std::vector<unsigned char> clustered(N, 0);\n    std::vector<int> unclustered(N);\n    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) unclustered[i] = i;\n    std::vector<Cluster> clusters;\n\n    std::vector<int> seedsSmall, seedsBig, cards;\n    seedsSmall.reserve(N);\n    seedsBig.reserve(N);\n    cards.resize(N);\n    std::vector<int> winnerMembers(maxCnt + 1);\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    while (!unclustered.empty()) {\n        // Round-robin distribution of this round's seeds over the ranks.\n        seedsSmall.clear();\n        seedsBig.clear();\n        int maxSmallCnt = 1;\n        for (size_t i = mpi_rank; i < unclustered.size(); i += mpi_size) {\n            const int s = unclustered[i];\n            const int c = static_cast<int>(offsets[s + 1] - offsets[s]);\n            if (c <= sharedCapCnt) {\n                seedsSmall.push_back(s);\n                maxSmallCnt = std::max(maxSmallCnt, c);\n            } else {\n                seedsBig.push_back(s);\n            }\n        }\n        // Only request as much shared memory as the largest candidate set of\n        // this round actually needs - this directly drives GPU occupancy.\n        const int smallShBytes = 12 * maxSmallCnt;\n\n        const int nSmall = static_cast<int>(seedsSmall.size());\n        const int nBig = static_cast<int>(seedsBig.size());\n        const int nLocal = nSmall + nBig;\n\n        if (nSmall > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds, seedsSmall.data(), sizeof(int) * nSmall,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            growClusterKernel<<<nSmall, blockSize, smallShBytes>>>(\n                g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds, nSmall, threshold, g.d_card,\n                nullptr, 0, nullptr, 0, 1);\n        }\n        if (nBig > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds + nSmall, seedsBig.data(), sizeof(int) * nBig,\n                                  cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n            for (int base = 0; base < nBig; base += g.maxGlobalBlocks) {\n                const int nb = std::min(g.maxGlobalBlocks, nBig - base);\n                growClusterKernel<<<nb, blockSize, 0>>>(\n                    g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds + nSmall + base, nb,\n                    threshold, g.d_card + nSmall + base, nullptr, 0, g.d_md2, g.mdStride, 0);\n            }\n        }\n        if (nLocal > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(cards.data(), g.d_card, sizeof(int) * nLocal,\n                                  cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        // Local best: maximum cardinality, smallest seed index on ties.\n        int bestCard = -1;\n        int bestSeed = INT_MAX;\n#pragma omp parallel if (nLocal > 8192)\n        {\n            int lc = -1, ls = INT_MAX;\n#pragma omp for schedule(static) nowait\n            for (int i = 0; i < nLocal; ++i) {\n                const int s = (i < nSmall) ? seedsSmall[i] : seedsBig[i - nSmall];\n                const int c = cards[i];\n                if (c > lc || (c == lc && s < ls)) {\n                    lc = c;\n                    ls = s;\n                }\n            }\n#pragma omp critical\n            {\n                if (lc > bestCard || (lc == bestCard && ls < bestSeed)) {\n                    bestCard = lc;\n                    bestSeed = ls;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Global reduction: MPI_MAXLOC yields max cardinality with the smallest\n        // seed index among ties - exactly the sequential selection rule.\n        struct {\n            int card;\n            int seed;\n        } in, out;\n        in.card = bestCard;\n        in.seed = (bestSeed == INT_MAX) ? INT_MAX : bestSeed;\n        MPI_Allreduce(&in, &out, 1, MPI_2INT, MPI_MAXLOC, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n\n        if (out.card <= 0) break;  // no more clusters can be formed\n\n        // Re-grow the winning cluster (single block) on every rank so that all\n        // ranks stay in sync without communicating the member list.\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_seeds, &out.seed, sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        const int wcnt = static_cast<int>(offsets[out.seed + 1] - offsets[out.seed]);\n        if (wcnt <= sharedCapCnt) {\n            growClusterKernel<<<1, blockSize, 12 * std::max(wcnt, 1)>>>(\n                g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered, g.d_seeds, 1, threshold, g.d_card,\n                g.d_members, maxCnt + 1, nullptr, 0, 1);\n        } else {\n            growClusterKernel<<<1, blockSize, 0>>>(g.d_pts, g.d_off, g.d_list, g.d_clustered,\n                                                   g.d_seeds, 1, threshold, g.d_card, g.d_members,\n                                                   maxCnt + 1, g.d_md2, g.mdStride, 0);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(winnerMembers.data(), g.d_members, sizeof(int) * out.card,\n                              cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        Cluster cluster;\n        cluster.seed_point = out.seed;\n        cluster.members.assign(winnerMembers.begin(), winnerMembers.begin() + out.card);\n        clusters.push_back(cluster);\n\n        for (int i = 0; i < out.card; ++i) clustered[cluster.members[i]] = 1;\n\n        unclustered.erase(std::remove_if(unclustered.begin(), unclustered.end(),\n                                         [&clustered](int idx) { return clustered[idx] != 0; }),\n                          unclustered.end());\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(g.d_clustered, clustered.data(), N, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n\n    cudaFree(g.d_pts);\n    cudaFree(g.d_off);\n    cudaFree(g.d_list);\n    cudaFree(g.d_clustered);\n    cudaFree(g.d_seeds);\n    cudaFree(g.d_card);\n    cudaFree(g.d_members);\n    if (g.d_md2) cudaFree(g.d_md2);\n\n    return clusters;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Validation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nbool validateClusters(const std::vector<Cluster>& clusters, const std::vector<Point>& points,\n                      const double threshold) {\n    bool valid = true;\n\n    printf(\"Validating clusters:\\n\");\n\n    const int nc = static_cast<int>(clusters.size());\n    std::vector<double> diameters(nc, 0.0);\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 1)\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        const auto& cluster = clusters[c];\n        double max_diameter = 0.0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < cluster.members.size(); ++i) {\n            for (size_t j = i + 1; j < cluster.members.size(); ++j) {\n                const double dist =\n                    distance(points[cluster.members[i]], points[cluster.members[j]]);\n                max_diameter = std::max(max_diameter, dist);\n            }\n        }\n        diameters[c] = max_diameter;\n    }\n\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        if (c < 10) {  // Print first 10 clusters\n            printf(\"  Cluster %d: size=%zu, seed=%d, diameter=%.4f\\n\", c,\n                   clusters[c].members.size(), clusters[c].seed_point, diameters[c]);\n        }\n\n        // Validate diameter is within threshold\n        if (diameters[c] > threshold * 1.001) {  // Allow small numerical error\n            printf(\"ERROR: Cluster %d has diameter %.4f > threshold %.4f\\n\", c, diameters[c],\n                   threshold);\n            valid = false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check for duplicate memberships\n    std::vector<int> membership(points.size(), -1);\n    for (int c = 0; c < nc; ++c) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < clusters[c].members.size(); ++i) {\n            const int member = clusters[c].members[i];\n            if (membership[member] >= 0) {\n                printf(\"ERROR: Point %d appears in multiple clusters (%d and %d)\\n\", member,\n                       membership[member], c);\n                valid = false;\n            }\n            membership[member] = c;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Count clustered points\n    int clustered_count = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < membership.size(); ++i) {\n        if (membership[i] >= 0) clustered_count++;\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Total points: %zu, Clustered: %d, Unclustered: %zu\\n\", points.size(), clustered_count,\n           points.size() - clustered_count);\n\n    return valid;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of points (default: 1000)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -t <float>   Distance threshold for clustering (default: 2.0)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n\n    int mpi_rank = 0, mpi_size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi_rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &mpi_size);\n\n    // One GPU per rank, assigned by node-local rank.\n    {\n        MPI_Comm local_comm;\n        MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, mpi_rank, MPI_INFO_NULL,\n                            &local_comm);\n        int local_rank = 0, local_size = 1;\n        MPI_Comm_rank(local_comm, &local_rank);\n        MPI_Comm_size(local_comm, &local_size);\n        MPI_Comm_free(&local_comm);\n\n        // Share the node's cores between the node-local ranks (unless the user\n        // pinned the thread count explicitly).\n        if (getenv(\"OMP_NUM_THREADS\") == nullptr) {\n            const int cores = omp_get_num_procs();\n            omp_set_num_threads(std::max(1, cores / std::max(1, local_size)));\n        }\n\n        int devCount = 0;\n        if (cudaGetDeviceCount(&devCount) != cudaSuccess || devCount == 0) {\n            if (mpi_rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"Error: no CUDA device available\\n\");\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(local_rank % devCount));\n
